text: what should i call you?
when were you born?
in your family, were you the...

interpretation.oldest: firstborn — over-indexes on self-reliance and responsibility; default-caretaker pattern
interpretation.middle: between-kid — often the negotiator or the one who slipped through; gap-filling role
interpretation.youngest: often underestimates own influence; can be magnetic, performative, or quietly resentful
interpretation.only child: adult-coded young; over-indexes on self-reliance and solitude as a default state

text: who came with you tonight?

interpretation.alone: unaccompanied — no group dynamic to filter for
interpretation.partner: romantic partner present — relational thread is live
interpretation.friends: peer group present — register may shift toward play
interpretation.family: family present — careful with edge questions

text: in a room of strangers, where do you end up?

interpretation.the center of it: magnetic / center-of-gravity register; performative comfort or compulsion
interpretation.the edges, watching: observer-coded; protective, measured, or genuinely contented at the margin
interpretation.depends on the room: high self-monitoring — context-sensitive; gap between public and private self likely live

text: where are you tonight?

interpretation.calm + in head: introspective; receptive register; will tolerate edge
interpretation.calm + with people: social and grounded; playful register fits
interpretation.chaotic + with people: festival-mode; lean theatrical; humor over depth

text: are you someone who...

interpretation.makes things happen: high-agency self-concept; choices framed as authored, even when they aren't
interpretation.watches things happen: observer-coded; agency may be defended or genuinely low-stakes by preference
interpretation.wonders what happened: retrospective / confused-coded; processes after the fact, often surprised by their own life

text: pick a creature.

interpretation.raven: watchful, slightly ominous; comfortable with weight
interpretation.serpent: patient, pattern-aware; will sit with discomfort
interpretation.wolf: pack-or-alone; loyalty and edge in same hand

text: if the last year were a season, which one?

interpretation.summer: peak / saturated; could be richly alive or overfull
interpretation.fall: letting go / ripening; transitional, possibly grief-adjacent
interpretation.winter: dormant / endured; conservation register, may be ready to thaw

text: what do you want from this?

interpretation.a laugh: play register; lean dry humor over depth
interpretation.a warning: wants edge; can land ominous beats
interpretation.clarity: has a thing in mind; choice already candidate

text: where you're from — does it still feel like home?

interpretation.here, and yes: rooted; geographic and felt origin aligned — stable base
interpretation.here, but no: physically rooted but psychologically elsewhere — quiet drift signal
interpretation.elsewhere, still home: elsewhere still anchors them; nostalgia, unfinished business, or chosen exile
interpretation.elsewhere, nowhere now: displaced; no felt home — unresolved tension worth handling gently

text: what's something people misread about you almost immediately?

interpretation.how serious i am: performs lightness; intensity hidden behind the casual register
interpretation.how soft i am: performs hardness; tender core behind the armor
interpretation.how alone i feel: performs connection; isolation hidden in a crowd
interpretation.i seem fine: high-functioning mask — the answer itself is the answer

text: who haven't you been honest with lately?

interpretation.myself: self-suspicion is live; tarobot can mirror it
interpretation.someone close: specific relationship under strain; probe gently
interpretation.pretty much everyone: performance fatigue; user may want to drop the mask
interpretation.no one: either genuinely settled or strong defenses; treat with curiosity

text: is there something you're putting off that you already know the answer to?
options: yes — and i know which one

interpretation.yes — and i know which one: direct choice candidate; tension is named
interpretation.no: either genuinely current or denial; cognition decides via cross-signal
interpretation.i don't think so, but: hedge — there is one, they just won't name it yet

text: the weight on your shoulders this week...

interpretation.boulder: something specific is heavy; probe domain

text: when something goes wrong, are you replaying it or planning what's next?

interpretation.replaying it: backward-facing; rumination, guilt and meaning-making active
interpretation.planning what's next: forward-facing; could be agency or could be avoidance
interpretation.both, at once: high cognitive load; processes in parallel — common with anxiety
interpretation.neither, mostly: either grounded or dissociative; cross-signal needed

text: who are you waiting for permission from?

interpretation.no one: agency claimed; may still be defended posture
interpretation.pass: declined; mark as edge-tolerance low for now

text: two years from now — same as today, or somewhere else?

interpretation.mostly the same: stability or stasis — chosen or imposed; ask which
interpretation.mostly different: transition register; change is live and possibly already chosen
interpretation.i can't picture it: uncertain — could be open, could be afraid of the blankness

text: an animal that genuinely unsettles you?

interpretation.spider: the watcher in clean spaces; intrusion, the pattern you didn't notice
interpretation.snake: the silent threat; betrayal-coded; quiet danger that arrives close
interpretation.deep-sea fish: the unknown depths; what's down there; unconscious material
interpretation.moth: the persistent / drawn-to-light; quiet repetition, gentle obsession

text: do you believe in free will?

interpretation.yes: agency-claiming worldview; choices framed as authored
interpretation.no: fated / determinist worldview; "things happen to me" register
interpretation.not sure: thoughtful; willing to sit with ambiguity
